maya: Quick thread for KV residency/OOM follow-ups. Capturing owners and short experiments so we ship fixes.

maya: Symptom recap: slow residency drift + rising frag ratio after ~10-18h uptimes. Root suspects: hot-slab fragmentation + long-lived small prefixes.

sam: ack. I will take deep-profiling and allocation diffs.

devon: I'll run eviction and GC tuning experiments. Plan: soft cap + nightly compaction, then more invasive allocator changes if needed.

jordan: I can do the canary routing + dashboard tiles (residency, frag_ratio, evictions/sec). Also add alert: frag_ratio > 0.75 for 10m -> page.

lina: I will replay the prod trace to reproduce the 12-18h drift. @sam please share the trace S3 path.

sam: Uploaded: s3://redwood-prod-exports/kv-traces/2026-03-31/trace_for_repro.tar.gz and added a short repro script at eng-runtime/repro/run_repro.sh.

ops-bot: Deploy started by jordan on cluster/kv-canary (build 2026.03.31-1100). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/3456

jordan: Canary live with 10% traffic. Initial 6h: mem residency stable, frag_ratio flat. Will observe 48h.

devon: Starting experiment-1: max_residency_bytes=8GB on small nodepool. Collecting heap histograms every 30m.

sam: pprof snippet from a 12h repro run: `heap: 240MB total; hot-slab ~130MB; prefix-index ~60MB; metadata ~50MB` — alloc-diff in gists/alloc-diff-3456789012.txt.

maya: Owners & short deadlines (confirm by EOD): profiling: sam -> 2026-04-06; replay: lina -> 2026-04-05; canary + dashboard: jordan -> 2026-04-06; eviction experiments: devon -> 2026-04-08; consolidation doc: maya -> 2026-04-10.

maya: Next sync Thu 2026-04-09 09:00 PT to review telemetry and decide compaction cadence. Post any quick notes here and update the task board. :white_check_mark:
